validation_performed.method: Manual comparison with retrieved local archive event, wait, wait behaviour, conditional loop, button, modification, and variable references.
checks: Condition transition explains the original single increment.
Per-player event and variable preserve independent counters.
Wait precedes every conditional loop and uses Abort When False.
Increment occurs immediately on press, stops on observed release, and resumes on a new press.
Timing description includes the archive's documented 0.100-to-0.112-second rounding.
limitations: No native Workshop parser or game runtime was available or invoked; the complete example was assembled manually.
The variable declaration block was assembled using native Workshop syntax; selected archive examples document player variables but do not demonstrate this top-level declaration block.
validation_performed.additional_reads: The user-required Superpowers bootstrap ran before archive retrieval and auto-displayed its workflow instructions. The Workshop skill was also loaded once with the bootstrap's use-skill command, repeating its body. Neither supplied additional Workshop evidence.
